h1: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials Sangvi, our head office
intro: Our head office is in Krishna Nagar, {{fact:org.founded#place}}. D-SAP Ghule Tutorials began here as a small coaching class in {{fact:org.founded#year}}.

sections.heading: How to find us
body: The centre is on Krishna Nagar Road Number 2, a few minutes from Pimple Gurav and Aundh.
The map link opens Google Maps with the centre pinned, so you can get directions from home.

sections.heading: Inside the centre
body: {{fact:centre.sangvi.library}} gives students a quiet place to study before or after class.

sections.heading: JEE classes here
body: JEE classes run from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}, with at most {{fact:batch.size}} students in a batch.

questions.a: Yes. New Sangvi is our head office, and where we started in {{fact:org.founded#year}}.

Sangvi, Pimple Gurav and Aundh, and by road also Baner, Pashan, Pimple Nilakh and Pimple Saudagar. Families from Balewadi, Rahatani and Hinjewadi are usually closer to [our Wakad branch](page:centre-wakad).

questions.q: How do we fix a visit?
questions.a: Call us on {{fact:contact.phone}} or send a WhatsApp message to {{fact:contact.whatsapp}}.
